bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 71; q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; for kind in routes pins incomplete; do case "$kind" in routes) sql="SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND board_key='area_bbs' AND purpose='announcement' AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL";; pins) sql="SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND state='published' AND pinned=TRUE AND message_id>0 AND token_hash IS NOT NULL";; incomplete) sql="SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND state IN ('needs_reconcile','publishing')";; esac; x=$(q "$sql") || exit 72; printf '%s=%s\n' "$kind" "$x"; done; printf 'IMAGE_SHA='; docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1; printf 'ENV_KEYS='; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E "^(DATABASE_URL|GAYBBS_BOT_TOKEN|TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN|BOT_TOKEN|GAYBBS_PUBLIC_MENU_RELEASE)$" | sort | paste -sd, -'
